color.note: Light only for now: dark mode is prepared (no raw colour in components) but not designed yet. In code each token is --color-<name> and a Tailwind utility (bg-surface, text-ink-muted, border-line...).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background, under the two halos.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, sidebar, bars, fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default borders and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered or editable borders, secondary button border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ghost and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, dates, metadata, uppercase section labels. Not for long text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interface accent (indigo-500): everything clickable or selected, fills, focus ring, active icons.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent as text on surface or accent-soft (indigo-700); hover of btn-accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills and hovers (indigo-50); btn-soft background; focus halo of fields.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent borders and guides (indigo-300), dashed drop zones.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Charts and progress only. Turquoise: a single series is ALWAYS data-1.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Charts only: second series (indigo).

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Charts only: third series (amber).

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Charts only: fourth series (rose).

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Charts only: fifth series (slate).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, done (emerald-500). Never alone: always with an icon or a text.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success badge or banner.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Success text on success-soft or surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved changes, pending (amber-500). Never alone.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning badge or banner.

tokens.name: warning-strong
tokens.usage: Warning text on warning-soft or surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error, deletion (red-600); btn-danger fill. Never alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error badge or banner.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Error text on danger-soft or surface; hover of btn-danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: New, neutral information (blue-500). Never alone.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an info badge or banner.

tokens.name: info-strong
tokens.usage: Info text on info-soft or surface.

tokens.name: domain-nutrition
tokens.usage: Nutrition icon tiles only (orange). Never on a button, a text or a chart.

tokens.name: domain-workouts
tokens.usage: Workouts icon tiles only (rose). Never on a button, a text or a chart.

tokens.name: domain-planning
tokens.usage: Planning icon tiles only (sky).

tokens.name: domain-habits
tokens.usage: Habits icon tiles only (violet).

tokens.name: domain-notes
tokens.usage: Notes icon tiles only (yellow).

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: First stop of the brand gradient (blue-500). Only inside --brand-gradient.

tokens.name: brand-indigo
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the brand gradient (indigo-500). Only inside --brand-gradient.

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Last stop of the brand gradient (purple-600). Only inside --brand-gradient.

tokens.name: halo-blue
tokens.usage: Top-left wash of the body background (the one signature).

tokens.name: halo-violet
tokens.usage: Top-right wash of the body background (the one signature).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Main values (a widget value, a big set count). Tabular numbers.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel, card and modal titles; header page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Focus on the descent, two seconds down.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Widget titles, field labels, compact buttons, user name.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, dates, trends, badges, uppercase section labels.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale, used through utilities (gap-3, p-6...). These are the steps the app actually uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a badge; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between header buttons, between list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card row; field horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header padding, page gutter on phones, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields; sidebar top padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop.

radius.note: These override Tailwind's rounded-sm / -md / -lg on purpose. The pill (9999px) is only for floating elements and badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small tiles (rounded-sm).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, icon tiles (rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, panels (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Floating bars (edit bar), badges, header round buttons. Nothing else.

shadow.note: One tint for every elevation: indigo-900 (--shadow-tint: 49 46 129 in code).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered card, active navigation entry.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating bar, held widget, modals, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Glow under the brand gradient only (btn-primary, logo tile).
